c123.note: The transcript quotes 'we will continue to wisely utilize equity financings when it makes sense going forward'. That fits the claim that dilution remains possible, even though management dismisses fears of endless dilution.

c124.note: Sean Goodman says about 10% of leases, around 85 a year, come up for renewal. Loss-making theaters that cannot be renegotiated may close.

c125.note: On the Q3 2026 call (Nov 5, 2026), Adam Aron said AMC has an exercise underway in Europe to reduce overhead above the theater portfolio, with potential to save more than $10 million of operating costs. Variant B has the same substance as the main claim.

c5.note: DEF 14A filed 2026-08-10 (record date 2026-07-31) lists Pentwater at 63,643,277 shares (7.13%) and Discovery Capital at 55,511,739 shares (6.22%) as holders.

c6.note: Matches the 2025 DEF 14A (as of Oct 13, 2025): Vanguard 5.95%, Discovery 5.78%, BlackRock 5.05%, Aron 975,310 shares, directors/officers as a group (19 people) under 1%. The cited Q3 2026 10-Q does not contain this table.

c45.note: Q2 2026 10-Q shows a six-month net loss of $128.5M, vs $206.8M a year earlier.

c47.note: The Sept 2026 8-K exhibit gives preliminary unaudited consolidated revenue of $1,334.8M for the two months ended Aug 31, 2026.

c52.note: The Q2 2026 10-Q does say cash burn rates are not sustainable long-term, but its liquidity section has no in-court/out-of-court restructuring warning. That language appears in the FY2025 10-K. Low-moderate confidence: neither check read the whole 10-Q (risk factors included).

c67.note: The Oct 2026 8-K confirms the $1,120M 2L term loan at a fixed 11.25%, maturing Oct 5, 2033. 'Keeps cost of debt high' is an interpretation.
